title: Dëkk bi nekk ci tefesu àtte ba
intro: Danga fekk sa bopp ci benn village bu nekk ci tefes gi, fu bruit vague yi di jaxasoo ak yuuxu nit ñuñ fàtte. Ñu daal di leen wax ñu noppalu, waaye seen ñàkka doylu moo jur ñu yar leen, te ba leegi ñu ngi koy wax ci kàddu yu woyof. Ndax mën nga xam ñooy kan?
clues: Danu dëkkoon ci tefes gi, ñu digal nu nu noppalu ci bis bi.
Bis boobu, jën yi dañu daan ñëw ci nun lu bari, waaye dañu nu tere jël.
Ñenn ci nun dañu àrtu ci njuumte, waaye ñeneen ñi dañu ko doon wut ngir napp.
Danu jàdd ndigal lu sell li ba indil sunu bopp mbugal mu metti.
Sunu mbugal mooy coppite bu nu bàyyi ci yaram wu ñaaw, rus ci nun.
Ñu soppi nu nekk ay maymu, muy màndarga ci ñépp ñiy ñëw ci sunu ginaaw.

arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
